entries.title: Psalms 149:1
segments: ¶Let the Lord be praised. Make a new song to the Lord, let his praise be in the meeting of his saints.

entries.title: Psalms 149:2
segments: Let Israel have joy in his maker; let the children of Zion be glad in their King.

entries.title: Psalms 149:3
segments: Let them give praise to his name in the dance: let them make melody to him with instruments of brass and corded instruments of music.

entries.title: Psalms 149:4
segments: For the Lord has pleasure in his people: he gives the poor in spirit a crown of salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
segments: Let the saints have joy and glory: let them give cries of joy on their beds.

entries.title: Psalms 149:6
segments: ¶Let the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hands;

entries.title: Psalms 149:7
segments: To give the nations the reward of their sins, and the peoples their punishment;

entries.title: Psalms 149:8
segments: To put their kings in chains, and their rulers in bands of iron;

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
segments: To give them the punishment which is in the holy writings: this honour is given to all his saints. Praise be to the Lord.
